marc:datafield.marc:subfield: ஆஸாதி : சுதந்திரம் · பாசிசம் · புனைவு | Aacaati : Sudanthiram · Passisam · Punaivu

"Aacaati: Sudanthiram Passisam Punaivu" by Arundhati Roy, translated into Tamil by G. Kuppusami, is a thought-provoking collection of essays that explore the concept of freedom in the face of growing authoritarianism. The book reflects on the powerful slogan " Aacaati," which resonates with both the freedom struggle in Kashmir and the resistance against Hindu nationalism in India. Roy delves into the deep connections and contradictions between these movements, offering a compelling meditation on language, fiction, and the human imagination during these unsettling times. Amidst the global pause brought by the COVID-19 pandemic, she challenges us to reconsider what freedom truly means and to envision a new world beyond the crisis.
